summary: An app's frame: the Sidebar beside a top bar and the page. On a phone the sidebar moves into a drawer the top bar opens.

props.name: title
props.description: The page heading in the top bar.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons at the end of the top bar. A New button stands in when unset.

props.name: children
props.description: The page. A list of recent files stands in when unset.

props.name: current
props.description: The `href` of the page being shown, marked as current.

props.name: workspaces
props.description: The workspaces the switcher lists; the first is the active one.

props.name: onWorkspaceChange
props.description: Called with a workspace's name when it is picked from the switcher.

props.name: user
props.description: Who is signed in, shown at the bottom of the sidebar with their menu.

props.name: onSignOut
props.description: Called when Sign out is picked from the user menu.

props.name: container
props.description: Where the drawer and menus are portalled. Leave unset to portal into `document.body`; pass an element to keep them inside a scrolling frame.
